name: surmai-travel
description: Read your self-hosted Surmai trips, review recorded expenses, and prepare itinerary changes for approval in Surmai.

interface.longDescription: Read trips, activities, lodging, transportation, expenses, and attachment metadata from your private Surmai instance. Prepare itinerary proposals with a preview and a link to approve them in Surmai. Access follows the linked Surmai user's permissions. Does not purchase travel, download attachment contents, or edit expenses.
defaultPrompt: Show my Surmai trips and summarize the next itinerary.
Help me plan itinerary changes for review in Surmai.
Review the recorded expenses for one of my trips.
